title: 第十五章 你滚开第十六章 我的荣耀皆属于你
slug: 共梦星际大佬后娇娇夜夜被宠哭
content_zh:
带着薄茧的大手沿着她浴巾边缘滑入，肆意地在她大片白腻的背脊和锁骨上游走。
他像是要确认什么，唇齿毫不客气地在她颈侧啃噬，很快便在那雪白的肌肤上留下一枚枚暧昧刺眼的红痕。
“唔……放开……”沈如卿难耐地扭动，眼泪瞬间涌了出来。
墨临看着那些红痕，眼底的暗色更浓，声音沙哑而危险：“装？接着装。
我的记忆可不会出错，无论是在那漫天风雪的雪原住处，还是在那摇晃震颤的飞船舱房里。
你都曾在我身下绽放，我可是吃了你整整两回。”
他贴着她的耳廓，恶意地吹气：“那时候你抱着我哭着求饶的样子，忘得这么快？
非要我帮你回忆回忆？”
沈如卿屈辱不已，身体止不住地颤栗。
但她死死咬着唇，拼命摇头。
她绝不能暴露自己记得梦境，更不能让他知道自己拥有偷取异能的能力。
于是，她将“柔弱小白花”扮演到了极致，眼泪大颗大颗地滚落，声音破碎而绝望：“放开我……求求你……我不认识你！
你是疯子……呜呜呜……我没去过什么飞船……我还是清白的……”
“清白？”
墨临动作一顿，随即冷笑一声，眼底闪过一丝疯狂的探究欲：“梦里你的初次可是给了我。
既然你嘴硬说不认识，那我就亲自检查一下。”
话音未落，他的手猛地顺着她的大腿探去，意图确认她所说真假。
“如果那里还是完整的，我就信你认错了人。
如果不是……”
“不要！！！”

沈如卿瞳孔骤缩，发出一声凄厉的尖叫。
她拼命并拢双腿，浑身紧绷得像块石头，哭喊得撕心裂肺：“不要碰我！求求你……你滚开！
你是变态！苍珏救我……苍珏……呜呜呜……”
她在极度恐惧中，本能地呼喊着那个能给她安全感的名字。
这一声“苍珏”，像是一盆冰水兜头浇在墨临头上。
看着身下雌性几乎要昏厥过去的惨状，那双眼里满是真实的恐惧和厌恶，完全不似作伪。
那种强烈的排斥感让墨临瞬间没了兴致。
他堂堂星际前战神，还不至于强迫一个吓破胆的雌性。
“该死！”
墨临低咒一声，猛地抽回手。
就在这时，他敏锐的听觉捕捉到了远处天空中传来的、推进器撕裂空气的爆鸣声。
content_en:
His large, calloused hands slid along the edge of her bath towel and roamed wantonly over her large white back and collarbone.
As if he wanted to confirm something, he nibbled at the side of her neck with his lips and teeth, and soon left ambiguous and dazzling red marks on the snow-white skin.
"Um... let go..." Shen Ruqing twisted impatiently, tears bursting out of her eyes instantly.
Mo Lin looked at the red marks, the darkness in his eyes became thicker, and his voice was hoarse and dangerous: "Pretend? Keep pretending.
My memory is unmistakable, whether it was in the snowfield residence filled with wind and snow or in the shaking cabin of the spaceship.
You bloomed under me, but I ate you twice. "
He pressed against her ear and blew maliciously: "The way you held me and cried for mercy at that time, did you forget so quickly?
Do you want me to help you recall your memories? "
Shen Ruqing was so humiliated that her body couldn't stop trembling.
But she bit her lip and shook her head desperately.
She must not reveal that she remembers dreams, let alone let him know that she has the ability to steal powers.
So, she played the role of "weak little white flower" to the extreme, tears rolled down her eyes, and her voice was broken and desperate: "Let me go... please... I don't know you!"
You are crazy... Wuwuwu... I have never been to any spaceship... I am still innocent..."
"Innocent?"
Mo Lin moved for a moment, then sneered, a trace of crazy desire for exploration flashed in his eyes: "In the dream, you gave me your first time.
Since you insist that you don't know it, I'll check it myself. "
Before he finished speaking, his hand suddenly moved down her thigh, intending to confirm the truth of what she said.
"If it's still intact, I believe you've got the wrong person.
If not..."
"No!!!"
Shen Ruqing's pupils shrank suddenly and he let out a shrill scream.
She squeezed her legs together desperately, her whole body was as tight as a stone, and she cried heartbreakingly: "Don't touch me! Please... get away!"
You are a pervert! Cangjue, save me...Cangjue...wuwuwu..."
In extreme fear, she instinctively called out the name that gave her a sense of security.
The sound of "Cang Jue" was like a basin of ice water poured on Mo Lin's head.
Looking at the tragic situation of the female under him who was almost fainting, those eyes were full of real fear and disgust, and they didn't seem to be fake at all.
That strong feeling of rejection made Mo Lin lose interest instantly.
He was a majestic interstellar former god of war, but he would not force himself on a frightened female.
"Damn it!"
Mo Lin cursed lowly and jerked his hand back.
At this moment, his keen sense of hearing captured the explosive sound of propellers tearing the air from the distant sky.
